traceability.notes:
Story 010.0-DEV-DEEP-VALIDATION is fully implemented.
The `valid-req-reference` rule and its helpers provide deep validation of `@req` and `@supports` annotations by: - Parsing referenced story files and extracting requirement IDs with a regex that is agnostic to markdown structure (REQ-DEEP-PARSE). - Matching each referenced requirement ID against the extracted set, reporting clear `reqMissing` diagnostics when not found (REQ-DEEP-MATCH, REQ-DEEP-ERROR). - Validating story paths, preventing path traversal and absolute paths, and enforcing project boundaries via `invalidPath` diagnostics (REQ-DEEP-PATH). - Caching parsed requirements per story file within a lint run to avoid repeated reads (REQ-DEEP-CACHE). - Supporting requirements in different file structures (standard stories, bullet lists, multi-story fixtures) and both `@story`/`@req` and `@supports` flows, which together satisfy the acceptance criteria around quality, integration, and user experience.
All relevant tests (unit and rule-level) pass, and the behavior is documented with examples in docs/rules/valid-req-reference.md. Based on concrete code, tests, and documentation, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are met.
